title: GOG Galaxy Library Playtime Hours Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gog:library playtime_hr=*
| stats sum(playtime_hr) as total_value, avg(playtime_hr) as avg_value by game_title
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks game values by total and average playtime hours across GOG Galaxy library events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `playtime_hr` values for each GOG Galaxy library event and review total and average playtime hours by game.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total playtime hours.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly keeps which game shows the biggest playtime hours numbers in your GOG Galaxy library data.
